item.title: Lux Pascal’s American Dream
item.description: The actor, model, and sister of Pedro Pascal had a thriving career in her native Chile—then left it behind to pursue stardom in the US. Her gambit’s paying off.

item.title: Olympic Figure Skater Isabeau Levito Pays Homage to Sophia Loren at the Winter Olympics 2026
item.description: After paying tribute to Audrey Hepburn last season, the American competitor with Italian roots emulated another timeless actor.

item.title: Jesse Jackson's Vanity Fair Profile from the 1988 Presidential Campaign
item.description: What does he want? Even as Democratic candidate Jesse Jackson wins hearts and minds in the Midwest, very little is known about the man behind the message. Gail Sheehy discovers that a sense of shame, a family rivalry, and an insatiable need for legitimacy have forged his character and drive. But does he really want the White House?

item.title: Vanity Fair and Four Seasons Celebrate the BAFTA Awards 2026
item.description: Before Sunday’s awards, Stellan Skarsgård, Damson Idris, Gugu Mbatha-Raw, Noah Jupe, and more kicked off a busy weekend in London.

item.title: Prince William Opens Up About When He Realized His Mental Health Was “Deteriorating”
item.description: In a candid interview with BBC Radio 1, Prince William recounted his journey of emotional awareness and confronting trauma in an effort to change the tides of Britain's mental health crisis.

item.title: Melania Trump Says American Fashion “Can Lead”—While She’s Dressed in European Labels
item.description: On Friday, the FLOTUS spoke at the Smithsonian about the power of American style. Her Bottega Veneta coat and Louboutins sent a different message.

item.title: In Oscar-Nominated Documentary The Perfect Neighbor, Police Catch—But Never Stop—a Killer
item.description: Susan Lorincz, a white Florida woman, relentlessly called the police on her own neighbors, ultimately shooting and killing Ajike Owens, a Black mother. In her Oscar-nominated doc, Geeta Gandbhir revisits the footage to show where humanity went wrong.

item.title: Alysa Liu and Her 'I Don't Give a Damn' Aesthetic Has Captivated The World
item.description: With her extraordinary style and carefree attitude, gold medal winning Alysa Liu has brought a breath of fresh air to the Milan Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn's Dog Died the Day After Her Devastating Olympics Crash
item.description: “The day I crashed, so did Leo,” the skier wrote of her 13-year-old dog.

item.title: Princess Désirée of Sweden Remembered at Private Stockholm Funeral Service
item.description: Princess Désirée was laid to rest in Stockholm this week, at a funeral attended by her brother, King Carl XVI Gustaf, among other members of the Swedish royal family.
